node.title: All-defect core-basis counting bounds truncated raw mass
node.statement: For a fixed actual dimension-s MCA carrier with empty universal carrier core, if every nonzero m-T joint-core subset has at least B ordered bases, set beta=(s+1)B and assume (T+1)m prod_(i=1)^(s-1)(d+i)>=kappa beta, with1<=kappa<=T+1 and1<=T<=d. Then sum min(raw,kappa)<=floor((n)_(s+1)/beta)=W. For1<=t<kappa the nested low-raw counts satisfy (t+1)|Gamma|-sum_(j=1)^t L_j<=W, hence (t+1)|Gamma|-t L_t<=W. Every selected raw defect gives a disjoint recoverable tuple insertion; high margins use the same original resource. No low-raw cap, source classification or Prize payment is assumed or proved here.
